crew.overview: When Christy discovers her 10-year-old daughter Anna has a rare, incurable disease, she becomes a ferocious advocate for her daughter’s healing as she searches for a solution. After Anna has a freak accident and falls three stories, a miracle unfolds in the wake of her dramatic rescue that leaves medical specialists mystified, her family restored and their community inspired.
crew.title: Miracles from Heaven

details.biography: T.D. Jakes emerged from his humble beginnings in West Virginia to become one of the most influential religious figures in the world. He's the founder and senior pastor of The Potter's House, a nondenominational Christian church based in Dallas, Texas with over 30,000 members.  A televangelist with a worldwide following, a best-selling author, and a producer of both faith-based and secular films.
details.name: T.D. Jakes
